calibration.issue: w4a HIGH: back fabric is a leaf print on a neutral ground with no mottle
calibration.status: superseded by 3469e77 (ANA dash grid). Against py_37305 the motif is now right: rectangular light dashes in rows with cell-snapped dark/light patches, row pitch within about 15 %. But it has a new problem at seat and row distance, which is the w5 high issue below.

calibration.issue: w4b MED: fabric motif too uniform / graphic
calibration.status: not fixed in a new form. The rows are now perfectly regular: the vertical autocorrelation peak is 0.43 in the q13 foreground and 0.49 in q14, against 0.02 (py_37302) and 0.02-0.09 (py_37301/37303). The light patches are large blocks, so the cloth reads as a barcode or digital camouflage.

calibration.issue: w4a MED: reading-light head vertical, lens on the end cap
calibration.status: fixed. The head is now at 50 deg with the lens on its side, and the silver bullet root points forward (py_37305, san_26).

calibration.issue: w4a MED: console cubbies too small, black slot
calibration.status: fixed against ANA. There are two equal pockets with blue corner triangles (py_37301 shows them equal), sockets, and the red tab with its blue strap. The dark opening above each plate matches the dark pocket mouth in py_37301.

calibration.issue: w4b MED: headrest wings show over the shell arch from behind
calibration.status: not verifiable: p2 and p6 crop the shell top and no w5 rear in-cabin view exists. The code keeps the shell square-shouldered (w 0.505 at 0.905, wing x 0.175 + 0.058).

calibration.issue: w4b MED: grey stub sticking out of the shell side (coat hook)
calibration.status: fixed. The coat hook is gone. The only side protrusion is the gooseneck root (0.06 silver bullet pointing forward), which matches san_26.

calibration.issue: w4a LOW: wing fleck hue / shape
calibration.status: partly fixed. They are now cream-white sakura chips, as in py_37305, but they render round and uniform and too dense (see issues).

calibration.issue: w4b LOW: wing pads darker than the back
calibration.status: fixed. In p4 the wing mean is #7c7f92 and the back #6f7485, matching the py_37305 wing/back order (#5a5c6b and #474b56).

calibration.issue: w4b LOW: literature-pocket mesh too tall
calibration.status: fixed as specified (0.30 x 0.065 window), but the real pocket is a deep bucket (san_20 and san_26), so the new issue below replaces this one.

calibration.issue: w4b LOW: leg struts too warm
w4b LOW: bottle-bin cups read as closed lids
calibration.status: fixed in code (recessed #6e7276 cup floors). No w5 render shows the bin clearly.

calibration.issue: w4a LOW: placards blank; flap flat
calibration.status: not fixed. The placards are still blank #e8e8e6 quads (p2, p6), and the flap is still a flat board.

details.detail: Overall massing and proportions in the ANA-camera mimic (p8 vs py_37301) and the cabin views (q13 vs py_37302, q14 vs py_37301/37303). These match: bolstered back, pillow wings, navy flap at h/w about 0.95, console 0.135 against a 0.415 cushion, slim window arm, aisle shroud, and the leg rest with its roller. Wing/flap width ratio: model 0.41, py_37302 foreground about 0.47.

Back and cushion fabric. Mean colour and contrast at cabin distance match: the q13 foreground back is #7a7f91 (p10/50/90 96/119/175) against py_37302 #6d7fa6 (94/120/169), and the q14 back is 93/113/171 against py_37303 83/181/220. But the structure is wrong. The rows are crisp and strictly periodic (vertical autocorrelation 0.43-0.49 against 0.02-0.09 in the photos), and the patches are large rectangular blocks, so every back reads as a barcode or camouflage. The photos read as a fine, soft speckle at that distance (py_37302 foreground, py_37301 left seat). At close range (p4 against py_37305) the dashes are too bright: (p90-p10)/p50 is 0.89 against 0.48, and the median sits on the ground (98 against p10 83), where in the photo it sits between ground and dash (96 between 74 and 120). The dashes also run about 30 % long: the model's 13.4 mm against about 10 mm (8 px at about 820 px/m, py_37305 lower right).

Headrest wings (sakura confetti). The tone is right and the chip size is right at close range: the chip/wing width ratio is about 0.09 in both p4 and py_37305. The chips are too uniform, though: round to hexagonal, all about 6 mm, evenly blue-noise spaced. At q13 distance they read as a white polka dot. In py_37302 the wings show small, irregular, sparser flecks at cabin distance. In py_37305 the petals vary from about 3 to 12 mm, are angular, and have many faint small specks between them.

Navy flap. Colour: q13 #263058 (B/R 2.27) against py_37302 #2f3e6f (2.35), and p4 #242b4d against py_37305 #22263f. The hem band shows. It is still a rigid flat board with no drape or soft lower edge (py_37305 shows a soft dent and a rounded hem).

Shell (front and side views). Relative to the wall it matches: q14 side #6c7482 against wall #b9bbc0 (0.62), and py_37301 shell side 0.63. In q13 the shell edge is 0.71 against py_37302's 0.65. The rear face is NOT checked in-cabin. The official rear view has the shell at 0.38 of the wall (py_37304 #494f57 against #c2d4eb), and san_13 has it at 0.40. In studio p2/p6 the rear face reads as very light grey (#93989f).
Seatback screen and placards. The bezel is set into the shell with a rim above it, as in py_37304. The two placards are blank white bars; py_37304 and san_26 carry two-line JP/EN text.

Literature pocket. In the model it is a flat panel with a thin black mesh window and stitched border, under a rounded tray rail. In the real photos (san_20, san_26; ANA shows none) it is a deep moulded bucket. A grey rigid frame/lip spans about 0.40, a pocket body bulges about 5 cm aft and holds an amenity kit and headset, and black mesh shows on the lower front of the bulge.

Console front face: two pockets with blue right-angle triangles, two square black universal sockets, a split lower block, and the red tab on its blue strap. These match py_37301 and py_37306 closely. The colour also matches: face #52596c in p8 against py_37301 #4a6089-#5a719b, with the photo bluer by its grade.

Console lid and cup nose. The lid is a light blue-grey with a groove (p8 #a3a7b2 against py_37301 #828ca0, slightly light). The cup nose is a raised light-grey box 5 cm tall with rounded edges, standing proud of the lid like a lunchbox (p1, p5, p8, q14). In py_37303 and san_16 the two cups are recessed flush in the lid front, inside a rounded tray rim; nothing stands up. Side plaque, handset dock and seam are present. The large horizontal silver tray-release handle on the side face (py_37301 right face, about 0.10 long) is only a 2 cm latch in the model.
Window-end armrest: a slim dark cantilever arm with a light top edge and a seat-letter square. It matches py_37301 (left seat) and san_14.
Aisle shroud: dark cap, recessed lighter panel, silver strip and handle recess, as in py_37303 and san_13. Acceptable.

Leg rest and roller. The skirt, leg rest and side links are right. The roller reads as a flat light rail with six pitch-black stripes (p5, p8). In py_37301 it is a round, darker slate cylinder, about 35-55 mm in diameter, with soft shallow grooves.

Footrest (rear). The model hangs a two-pad ribbed bar (0.30 overall) on ONE diagonal arm. san_20, a real 2023 photo of the stowed footrest, shows TWO near-vertical parallel silver arms about 6 cm apart at the centre, carrying a single ribbed dark bar with silver sleeves, about 0.2 m wide.
Bottle bin and legs: a floor-standing brushed bin with two cups and a placard, and light aluminium legs. These match san_17 and san_20.

Gooseneck reading light: black hose about 19 mm, brushed head about 38 x 110 mm with a side lens, and a silver bullet root pointing forward. This matches py_37305 and san_26. In q13 the heads hang a little low and the hose looks dead matte black; the real hose is braided with a sheen.

issues.issue: Back and cushion dash grid reads as a crisp, strictly periodic barcode with large camouflage blocks, not ANA's fine soft dash weave. This is the most visible surface in every PY view.
issues.evidence: Vertical autocorrelation at the row pitch: q13 0.43 and q14 0.49 against py_37302 0.02, py_37301 0.09 and py_37303 0.02 (high-passed luminance, crops q13 240-340 x 440-560, q14 260-420 x 300-420). Close-up p4 300-460 x 340-470 has (p90-p10)/p50 0.89 with p50 98 at the ground (p10 83, p90 170); py_37305 650-900 x 470-575 has 0.48 with p50 96 midway (74/120). The dash is about 13.4 mm in the tile against about 10 mm in py_37305 (8 px at about 820 px/m from the 0.28 m flap = 230 px). The light patches in the tile are up to 3 cols x 4 rows (60 x 33 mm) with the gaps closed, which shows as big white blocks in p8 and q14.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py synth_py_back: rows 20 -> 24 (pitch 6.8 mm). Dash length rng.normal(21,5) clip(10,30) -> rng.normal(16,4) clip(8,24). Add per-dash y jitter (yc + rng.uniform(-1.2,1.2) px per (r,c)) and x jitter ±6 px. Offset odd rows by 0.25*cw so the columns are not perfectly aligned. Band half-thickness 3.2 -> 2.6 px. Dark patches: dim uniform(0.2,0.4) -> (0.5,0.7), size 1 col x 1-2 rows, count 10 -> 16. Light patches: count 5 -> 3, size 1-2 cols x 1-2 rows, x1.3 -> x1.15, drop the close[] gap-closing. Dash gain: out = 1 + 2.6*lite -> 1 + 1.5*lite. Add fine weave grain: out *= np.exp(0.07*g/g.std()) with g = _blur_wrap(rng.normal(0,1,(S,S)),0.7). Re-run and check in the q13/q14 crops: row autocorrelation < 0.2, and (p90-p10)/p50 about 0.5 at p4 and about 0.6 at q13, with the mean unchanged. Keep PHOTO_ENC py_back 4 and the pyFabric base #848896.

issues.issue: Console cup nose is a raised light-grey box standing about 5 cm proud of the lid; the real cups are recessed flush in the lid front.
issues.evidence: p1, p5, p8 and q14 show a 'lunchbox' block at the console front. py_37303 (console front top, x 335-370, y 225-245) and san_16 show two round cups sunk into a rounded tray rim, flush with the lid surface. py_37301 shows a flat white-grey cap at the front corner.

issues.issue: Literature pocket is a flat panel with a thin mesh slot; the real pocket is a deep moulded bucket with a rigid frame.
issues.evidence: san_20 (looking down at the seatback) and san_26: a grey rigid frame about 0.40 wide across the top, and a pocket body bulging about 5 cm aft holding an amenity kit and headset in a bag. Black mesh covers the lower front of the bulge, about 0.33 x 0.06. Against these, p6_back_close and p2 read as a flat sticker. ANA's official set shows no rear view this low, so the real photos win for geometry.

Replace the flat gRBox(0.36,0.17,0.016) with a loft that bulges aft: loftAt(B,[SEC(0.05,0.36,0.02,0.01,0.008),SEC(0.10,0.38,0.06,0.03,0.02),SEC(0.17,0.38,0.05,0.025,0.02),SEC(0.21,0.36,0.02,0.01,0.008)], M4.mul(BH, M4.trs(0, py0, zr(py0+0.12))), SEATMAT.pyShell, 3), with sections y/w/d along the back. Move the mesh to the lower front of the bulge: gBox(0.33,0.06,0.003) at on(0.085+py0, 0.06) in LAYER.grille.

issues.issue: Wing confetti chips are uniform round dots that read as a polka dot at cabin distance.
issues.evidence: q13 wing crop 305-345 x 300-410 against py_37302 670-740 x 300-400: the photo flecks are small, irregular and sparser. In py_37305 230-320 x 120-300 the petals range from about 3 to 12 mm, with many faint 1-2 mm specks. The tile has 14 chips, all with req N(10,2) clip 7-13 px, blue-noise at 45 px.

Spacing 45 -> 38 px. Add 30 mid specks of radius 2-3.5 px at gain 1.5-2.5. Softened-facet exponent 0.7 -> 1.0 (sharper corners).
